title: The Radio Said My NAME 📻
premise: In a sunny town where the morning radio reads out one name and nobody may go near that person all day, the radio says mine, and a whole street steps away from me while my oranges roll.
twist: The worst day of your life was never bad luck, only a whole town staying away, so the day my best friend Dev stays with me, nothing goes wrong, and the next morning we go to the next person named.
world: A pastel main street on a Saturday with a bakery, a cafe with a striped awning, a bus shelter and a park bench, a kitchen with an old stone radio, and a white porch.
